Good app; but... Can't stop playing Athan. App's widget only shows prayer timings. If widget can also show Location, and Islamic and Gregorian dates then that would be great. Also, widget's fonts are small and hard to read. Plus, colour theme is not good. App's interface is very cluttered and confusing. There is no option available to adjust Sunrise or Qiyaam times, but prayer times can be adjusted. Finally, too many ads, especially fullscreen ones.
Best app for salat reminder, dua, dhikir and reciting quraan. Plus many functionalities such as qibra identification.

Best App for every Muslim brothers and sisters. they're not like any other app, they don't force their users to pay for extra features. This app has nearly everything a muslim needs which is so astonishing. Love this app and may Allah swt grant jannah to the developers of this app, Ameen.
I purchased to have ads removed and it has made my experience much more enjoyable! As a revert, I love being able to check-off my daily prayers, or switch to menstrual mode. Athan is like my toolbox.

While the app includes dhikr and duas, I personally wish there were a lot more dhikrs and supplications available. It would be great if the app expanded the list to include additional morning and evening athkar, more varied tasbih sequences, and perhaps thematic dhikr collections throughout Ramadan. One challenge I’ve noticed is that the font for the dhikr and Qur’an sections feels a bit small, I wish there was a way to make the font bigger and easier to see.

This app is truly amazing for tracking prayers and maintaining daily dhikr. It’s simple, helpful, and very well designed. I only have one humble suggestion: please consider adding an “Add New Dhikr” option so users can include their personal supplications as well. That feature would make the app even more beneficial.
